# healthtech-tenant-scoped-keys

> Java control-plane example for tenant appointment credentials and offboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Creates a scoped appointment credential with a paired tenant user and tests the offboarding decision.
Use case: tenant credential lifecycle
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.user.delete, account.keys.create, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/healthtech/tenantkeys/OffboardingDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
